extraction_report.paper_summary: PPLM: a paired-sequence protein language model that produces inter-protein embeddings and attention for three downstream tasks: binary PPI prediction (PPLM-PPI), binding affinity estimation (PPLM-Affinity), and inter-protein contact/interface prediction (PPLM-Contact). PPLM-Affinity fine-tunes the final PPLM layer and predicts ΔG (binding affinity) from sequence embeddings.
extraction_report.research_objective: Provide a sequence-only, paired-protein LM to predict PPIs, binding affinities (ΔG), and inter-protein contacts/interface residues, improving over single-sequence LMs and some structure-based methods.
identified_experiments: PPLM-Affinity: predict protein–protein binding affinity (ΔG) from receptor+ligand sequences (5-fold CV ensemble).
PPLM-PPI: binary interaction prediction from sequence pairs.
PPLM-Contact / PPLM-Contact2: inter-protein contact and interface residue prediction using PPLM features + MSA/structure features.

workflow_definitions.paper_reference: Figure 1C; Sections 'Binding affinity prediction using PPLM' and Results (PPLM-Affinity)

workflow_definitions.notes: run_pplm-affinity.py ensembles 5 CV models from weights/affinity_models.pkl and prints a single scalar prediction. The model returns ΔG (paper units). README shows example output -7.6090136 (interpreted as kcal/mol in the paper).

workflow_definitions.objective: Predict probability that two proteins interact from two FASTA sequences.
ambiguity_notes: ppi_models.pkl must be downloaded; not present in repository snapshot.
workflow_definitions.notes: run_pplm-ppi.py uses ensemble weights and prints an interaction score.

Pretrained contact weights must be downloaded via weights/download_weights.sh.
